agent_explanation: Massive bodies 0 (~11.6) and 4 (~12.6) undergo a close encounter to distance ~0.32 near softening 0.3 with speeds ~10. With dt~0.03 and only 6 substeps per step, leapfrog cannot resolve the sharp force peak, causing large energy drift that violates energy_conserved at step 33. Reducing dt to 0.001 removes the failure.
